comparison.objective: Exchange a depleted mobile-robot battery with a charged one between an occupied bay and charger; candidate breaks and recovers insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Battery swap tests ordered extraction, hand-off, and constrained pack placement; candidate tests coaxial mandrel use, controlled striking, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Charged pack must be within 1 cm of the bay and depleted pack within 2.5 cm of the charger, with half credit for one half; candidate requires four safe fractures and all fragments contained.
comparison.reason: Although both concern robot assembly or service, battery exchange does not test impact fracture, coil retention, or debris containment.
